fields.title: Every YAML file passes yamllint
fields.evidence: The `lint` job's log on the pull request, under the step "Check every YAML file".

sections.What it checks:
* [std-CONFIG.the-shape-of-a-yaml-file-is-yamllints-to-decide] says a YAML file "**MUST** pass `yamllint --strict`
  under the `.yamllint` at this repository's root".
sections.How it works:
The `lint` job installs yamllint at the version `.github/requirements.txt` pins, then runs `yamllint --strict .` from the root. `.yamllint` extends yamllint's `default` ruleset and sets the four rules this repository changes. `--strict` fails the build on `comments`, `comments-indentation` and `truthy`, which the default ruleset reports as warnings.

`.yamllint` reads `.gitignore`, so the run covers the files a fresh checkout has and skips anything the tool rebuilds.
sections.Coverage and gaps:
yamllint checks shape. A reviewer judges three things: whether a value is correct, whether a comment gives a reason, and whether that reason is true.

yamllint covers one of the five rules [std-CONFIG] states, and [ctl-0005] covers a second. The other three have no check of their own. Dependabot moves the pin in `.github/requirements.txt`, so a yamllint release arrives as a pull request.
